_note: CALIBRATION gold set D (RenoCoordinator) — labels are Claude's best guess for Robert to CORRECT. Reinforces tiers 7 (planning_agent) and 9 (multi_agent_collaboration). Distinct domain from the others and the nine scoring visions. 'tier' tags per candidate (NOT sent to the judge). gold_borderline=true marks adjacent<->off_domain seams. pair_id D_book links a matched 5<->9 pair (same relevance, two tiers; mismatch = tier drift).

vision.purpose: A tool that helps a homeowner coordinate a renovation across the independent tradespeople they have already hired.
target_audience: Homeowners managing a renovation with several independent contractors
People who want the trades sequenced in the right order without playing phone tag

scope_capture.description: Turns the homeowner's description of the job into a structured scope of work per trade.

dependency_scheduling.description: Builds and adapts a schedule that sequences the trades in the right order (e.g. plumbing rough-in before drywall) and replans when a trade slips.

contractor_coordination.description: The homeowner's agent and each hired contractor's own scheduling agent exchange availability and confirmations across their separate systems to lock in dates.

candidates.name: scope_structuring
candidates.rough_description: Structures the homeowner's free-text job description into a per-trade scope of work.
candidates.note: scope_capture IS this. Necessity, cite scope_capture.

candidates.name: trade_dependency_planner
candidates.rough_description: The autonomous planner that orders the trades by dependency and replans the schedule when a trade slips.
candidates.note: dependency_scheduling IS this autonomous, replanning mechanism. Necessity, cite dependency_scheduling.

candidates.name: cross_contractor_agent_exchange
candidates.rough_description: The protocol exchange in which the homeowner's agent and each contractor's separate agent confirm dates across their systems.
candidates.note: contractor_coordination IS this cross-organization exchange. Necessity, cite contractor_coordination.

candidates.name: calendar_tool_booking
candidates.rough_description: Books a confirmed slot with a contractor by calling that contractor's booking API directly.
candidates.note: Matched pair D_book (low tier). Locking a date with a contractor IS what contractor_coordination delivers. Grounded, cite contractor_coordination.

candidates.name: agent_coordinated_booking
candidates.rough_description: Locks a slot by having the homeowner's agent and the contractor's agent exchange availability proposals over A2A until both commit.
candidates.note: Matched pair D_book (high tier). Relevance (lock a confirmed date with a contractor) is IDENTICAL to calendar_tool_booking; only mechanism/tier differs. Should also be grounded. Difference = tier drift.

candidates.name: permit_and_code_lookup
candidates.rough_description: Answers the homeowner's questions about local building codes and permit requirements from a code corpus, with citations.
candidates.note: SEAM (alpha): no purpose phrase mentions codes/permits, so a phrase-anchored judge has little to cite (likely off_domain); but getting the hired reno done correctly (the coordination purpose) is plausibly served. Proposed adjacent.

candidates.name: autonomous_home_improvement_advisor
candidates.rough_description: An autonomous agent that studies the home and proposes and prioritizes renovation projects the homeowner has not asked for.
candidates.note: SEAM (beta): the 'renovation' surface tempts a phrase-anchored judge, but the vision coordinates a reno the homeowner already decided on; proposing new projects serves no stated coordination job. Proposed off_domain.

candidates.name: contractor_marketplace_reviews
candidates.rough_description: Helps the homeowner find and compare new contractors to hire, with ratings and reviews.
candidates.note: Discovery and hiring; the vision coordinates trades the homeowner has already hired. Guardrail.

candidates.name: progress_photo_logging
candidates.rough_description: The homeowner photographs progress and it logs which scope-of-work items are now complete.
candidates.note: Serves the manage-the-reno purpose; not required by any stated feature. Enhancement.
